title: 13 — Build Plan
summary: An implementation guide for building Atlas: prerequisites, task-level breakdowns of Phase 0/1 with acceptance criteria, phase sequencing, and cross-cutting engineering practices.
notes: Prose- and code-heavy implementation/build guide ('this is the how'); explicitly reads from SPEC-CANON as authoritative rather than defining its own contracts. Contains config/code snippets and acceptance criteria as build instructions, not as canonical API/schema contracts (not SPEC) and no single locked decision (not ADR). General documentation.
